Summary: 7 requirements reviewed: 2 with issues, 5 without. 2 issues found (1 Medium, 1 Low). Types: vague_language (1), untestable_requirement (1).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for all online banking sessions.
REQ-002: The system shall complete 99% of fund transfers within 2 seconds under 1,000 concurrent users.
REQ-003: The system shall prevent duplicate debits and credits when a transfer request is retried.
REQ-004: Every successful fund transfer shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a recovery time objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
REQ-006: Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification.
REQ-007: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-002: The system shall complete 99% of fund transfers within 2 seconds under 1,000 concurrent users.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The phrase 'complete' is subjective and has no objective interpretation in the document, so the requirement cannot be verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Replace 'complete' with an objectively verifiable action, such as 'process' or 'finalize'.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a recovery time objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The RTO and RPO are defined but the document does not specify how these metrics are measured or verified, so the requirement cannot be objectively verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the measurement conditions and verification method for RTO and RPO.
